name: Slides
description: PPT assistant: fast editable decks (pptxgenjs baseline) plus the vendored PPT-Master refinement pipeline (native DrawingML, consulting-grade), with an isolated guarded Python runtime.
author: LaboFlow

agentTools.name: slides_plan
agentTools.description: Normalize and validate a slide-deck outline you drafted from the conversation (fast L1 engine). Returns the canonical outline — show it to the user for review BEFORE calling slides_export. Input: { topic, outline: { deckTitle, pages } }.

agentTools.name: slides_export
agentTools.description: Export a confirmed outline as an editable .pptx (fast L1 engine: native text boxes/tables). Input: { deckTitle, pages: [{ layout, title, bullets?, data?, quote?, speakerNotes? }], theme? }. Call only after the user confirmed the outline.

agentTools.name: ppt_master_status
agentTools.description: Check the PPT-Master (L2 精制引擎, vendored ppt-master) Python runtime and get { stage, skillDir, pythonPath, doctor }. ALWAYS call first before PPT-Master work; use the returned paths for every script call — never guess.

agentTools.name: ppt_master_setup
agentTools.description: Install the isolated PPT-Master Python runtime (venv + MIT-only requirements + AGPL guard) as a background job. Returns { jobId } — poll with ppt_job_status. Call only when the user asked for L2 setup or approved it.

agentTools.name: ppt_job_status
agentTools.description: Poll a PPT plugin background job (setup installs etc). Input { jobId } or {} for the recent list. Keep polling while status is running.

agentTools.name: ppt_read_doc
agentTools.description: Read the vendored PPT-Master skill corpus the ppt-master skill routes to (workflows/references/docs/template indexes). Input { path } corpus-relative; directories list their readable entries. Text only, ≤1MiB.

settings.title: Output folder (workspace-relative)
settings.description: Where .pptx files are written inside the workspace
